card.name: Period after visual inspection warnings
card.fires_on: Mostly the period ending a sentence about observing cloudiness, discoloration or particles in a product before use. Weaker, scattered hits on other mid-sentence words in unrelated text.

modes.description: Weak hits on assorted words such as can, than, to or given in general or label prose with no shared theme.

card.writes: Little clear effect; it slightly favors emphatic or connective words like terrific, likewise and tremendous over words like meticulously and intricate.
card.plain: It mostly marks the end of the sentence telling you to check a product for cloudiness or particles before use.
